_provenance: issue #53's closing residue: the 13 types every family sweep declined to classify, each because one TF resource spans multiple CFN types (or none cleanly) in a way no single alias or fold_parent can honestly assert. Each reason is the sweeping agent's own finding, verified against the provider's and CloudFormation's docs at sweep time.

nones.aws_cloudformation_type: one TF resource registers any extension kind; the registry splits it across AWS::CloudFormation::{Resource,Module}{Version,DefaultVersion} by kind
nones.aws_directory_service_directory: creates SimpleAD, MicrosoftAD, or ADConnector depending on its type argument - three CFN targets, no single alias
nones.aws_dx_bgp_peer: attaches to private, public, or transit VIFs via a bare virtual_interface_id - no single fold parent among the three DirectConnect VIF types
nones.aws_dynamodb_table_replica: legacy per-table replica API; AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable's Replicas is plausible but the correspondence to a plain Table's replica is unconfirmed
nones.aws_iam_outbound_web_identity_federation: semantics too obscure to classify with confidence; no registry candidate found
nones.aws_iam_user_group_membership: the reverse-direction shape of AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition (one user to many groups vs one group to many users) - the correspondence is not clean
nones.aws_lambda_function_scaling_config: no registry candidate identified with confidence at sweep time
nones.aws_lambda_provisioned_concurrency_confi: targets either a Lambda alias or a raw version - two possible fold parents, no single correct one
nones.aws_networkmanager_attachment_routing_po: CFN models RoutingPolicyLabel as a property on several NetworkManager attachment types; the TF resource attaches generically across all of them
nones.aws_security_group_rule: creates an ingress or egress rule by its type argument, and both AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup{Ingress,Egress} are already claimed by the split per-direction TF types
nones.aws_servicecatalog_constraint: one TF resource spans five distinct AWS::ServiceCatalog::*Constraint types depending on its type field
nones.aws_ses_domain_identity: AWS::SES::EmailIdentity is already claimed by aws_ses_email_identity/aws_sesv2_email_identity; asserting a third synonym needs a decision, not a sweep guess
nones.aws_vpc_security_group_rules_exclusive: an exclusive-set manager spanning both SecurityGroupIngress and SecurityGroupEgress - no single CFN counterpart
